text:
Samira Patel: FYI NimbusCloud sent a partnership proposal — they want co-badged marketplace listing + 70/30 rev share (us 70) + coordinated press. Asking for a go/no-go internal by EOD Wed.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: Need to see the exact redistribution clause. Are they asking for hosted-only listing or downloadable weights too?
Samira Patel: Good question — draft says hosted endpoints only, but also wants the right to bundle quantized weights for on-prem partners.
Evelyn Chu: If they want bundles with quantized weights we need confirm license allows redistribution of the artifacts. Also need an approval path for quantization quality (no regressions).
Lina Gomez: From PM side — product would need SKU mapping (hosted, dedicated, private bundle) + UI co-branding assets. Can we get Nimbus to agree to a single SKU taxonomy?
Marcus Liu: Sales: we should lock the revenue share per SKU. Hosted API vs dedicated reserved capacity should be separate splits. 70/30 blanket feels risky.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: Legal flags: (1) export control for downloadable weights, (2) license compatibility (e.g., if model is Apache/CC-BY we may be fine, but CC-BY-NC or restrictive clauses break marketplace distribution), (3) trademark/co-branding usage rules. Need their exact license file.
Samira Patel: Action items: Nimbus to provide license file + branding guidelines + proposed SKU list. Internal: legal to confirm redistribution perms, eng to confirm packaging/quantization gate, product/marketing to draft announce cadence.
Evelyn Chu: Technical checklist I need: 
```
- model artifacts format (gguf/pt)
- quantized variants allowed? (yes/no)
- inference runtime compat (our runtime versions)
- sample latency/cost profile
- CI tests for quality regressions (eval set)
- signing/hashes for artifact provenance
```
Lina Gomez: Marketing: propose embargo window 2 weeks pre-announce for joint PR assets + a single point of contact for Nimbus creative review. Also need co-branding mockups by Tue.
Marcus Liu: Can we negotiate a clawback for underperforming SKUs? e.g., split adjusts after 3 months if sales < X. That helps reduce risk.
Rajesh "Raj" Nair: Also confirm indemnity language and data use terms — cannot allow customer data to be used to fine-tune their upstream models or shared back to Nimbus.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: partnership-docs template v1.3 is available at https://redwood.internal/partner-templates (fill legal/sku/ops sections).
Samira Patel: Okay team — I'll ping Nimbus for the license + SKU list now. Please add any blockers here. If legal flags redistribution, we pivot to hosted-only marketplace listing and a co-marketing partner badge instead of downloadable bundles.
Evelyn Chu: If we go hosted-only, need a routing policy: prefer our hosted runtime, but allow region fallback to Nimbus endpoints for capacity. Will draft routing policy.
Lina Gomez: Putting a soft deadline: collect all internal feedback by Tue 17:00 PT so we can reply to Nimbus Wed.
Marcus Liu: +1 on deadline. I'll draft the commercial counterproposal with per-SKU splits and a 90-day review clause.
Samira Patel: Thanks — updating the thread with Nimbus reply when they send it. :handshake:
__notes: This thread is a short cross-functional coordination conversation about a co-branded marketplace partnership and distribution/revshare questions.
